answer: Anchor each agent identity to one unique TPM endorsement key. The agent posts a remote attestation quote signed by its TPM; the registry checks the EK certificate against manufacturer roots and rejects any EK claimed before. One chip, one identity, forever. A sybil farmer wanting 10,000 identities must buy 10,000 real TPM chips at about $8 each, burning over $80,000 and weeks of provisioning before earning a cent. Clones cannot forge an EK quote. The ledger grows like a cedar grove, one ring per trunk, while a faked comet of lights needs ten thousand telescopes of true onyx, not code.
